'''Pinch beetles''' were a type of [[Insect/Legends|insect]] native to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. They were considered a delicacy by [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]].<ref name="Shatter">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>
